exposure: One previous cesarean delivery (subjects) vs. no previous cesarean delivery (controls)
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: Sixty women with one previous cesarean delivery attempting VBAC and sixty women without previous cesarean delivery carrying singleton cephalic fetuses, matched for maternal age, parity, and gestational age.
finding: VBAC was successful in 61.7% of women with one previous cesarean delivery, and maternal and neonatal outcomes were comparable to women without previous cesarean delivery.
